terbaru.judul: Numerical methods for lambda quantiles: robust evaluation and portfolio optimisation
terbaru.pelajaran: This work presents efficient algorithms for computing lambda quantiles and demonstrates their application in portfolio optimisation.

terbaru.judul: Constraint Preserving XY-Mixers under Trotterized Adiabatic Evolution
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a theoretical analyses of the origin and scaling of Trotter errors in XY-mixers and show that the dominant contribution depends on the size and structure of individual constraints rather than on the total problem size.

terbaru.judul: Decision-Induced Ranking Explains Prediction Inflation and Excessive Turnover in SPO-Based Portfolio Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: This study provides a KKT-based interpretation showing that portfolio decisions can be viewed as ranking over risk- and transaction-cost-adjusted marginal scores.

terbaru.judul: Optimal Merton's Problem under Multivariate Affine Volterra Models with Jumps
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper is concerned with portfolio selection for an investor with exponential, power, and logarithmic utility in multi-asset financial markets allowing jumps.

terbaru.judul: A Systematic Review of Recent Advancements in PINN Augmented Deep Learning and Mathematical Modeling for Efficient Portfolio Management
terbaru.pelajaran: In finance, portfolio management is a traditional yet difficult problem that has drawn attention from practitioners and researchers for many years.
We propose Sampler-Robust Optimization (SRO), which optimizes decisions against the worst-case sampler induced by perturbing the learned generator.

terbaru.judul: Comparative Evaluation of Modern Deep Learning Methodologies for Portfolio Optimization
terbaru.pelajaran: This study proposes a portfolio optimization framework that integrates advanced deep learning architectures with traditional financial models to enhance risk-adjusted performance.

terbaru.judul: FlashFolio: A GPU-Accelerated Solver for Portfolio Optimization
